mapper.select: SELECT p.p_id, p.p_title, p.p_sale_type, p.p_sale_price, i.pi_storage FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_image i ON p.p_id = i.pi_product_id WHERE p.p_sale_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY p.p_created_at DESC, p.p_id DESC
